I think it's generally good idea to keep all the fields in the JSON representations of objects which makes it easier for clients to consume them since they don't need to do additional check on the existence of the fields. 

To your second point, I kind of prefer to avoid three-valued logic for boolean fields, unless there's substantial semantic difference between `null` and `false`. I feel in this case if the relocating node is null, so it can't be desired, thus `relocating_node_is_desired` being `false` makes sense.
